items.statement: Q1 FY27 was STL's best ever quarter, with revenue up 87% year on year to Rs 1,910 crore.
items.quote: a truly historic quarter where STL delivered its highest ever performance across revenue, EBITDA and PAT. Revenue reached INR1,910 crores, representing an extraordinary 87% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: PAT hit a record Rs 197 crore, a 10% margin, the highest ever.
items.quote: Finally, PAT came in at a record INR197 crores, reaching 10% of revenue, our highest PAT margin ever

items.statement: Optical connectivity attach rate rose to 16% from 15% on a much larger cable revenue base.
items.quote: we are pleased to share that our attach rates have increased to 16% on a much larger OFC revenue base compared to 15% last year.

items.statement: Gross margin is under pressure as war-related input costs pushed key raw material prices up sharply.
items.quote: So, Tej, on the gross margin, yes, there is some sort of pressure which is coming from the input cost broadly with all the war situation, the prices of the key raw material getting increased to significant multiples.

items.statement: Data centre and enterprise should reach 50% of revenue this fiscal, well above the earlier 30% guidance.
items.quote: Looking ahead, we expect the combined data center and Enterprise segment to scale up to 50% of the revenues in the current fiscal, well above the 30% guidance provided in our previous earnings call.

items.statement: The order pipeline gives strong revenue visibility for the year.
items.quote: This robust order pipeline provides strong revenue visibility and reinforces our growth outlook for the year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance was raised to 23% after the 20% target was already met in Q1.
items.quote: which is up 184% year-on-year. We are now revising our EBITDA margin guidance upward to 23%.

items.statement: The company targets an attach rate above 20% from next quarter and 25% by year end.
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are focused on further increasing our attach rate to above 20% from next quarter onwards and to 25% by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Hyperscaler capex should continue, raising demand for STL's portfolio.
items.quote: So we do continue to see that this capex will continue from the hyperscalers. And on the back of that, the demand for our portfolio will continue to increase.

items.statement: Demand currently exceeds supply.
items.quote: So it does seem to be that the demand is outstripping supply currently.

items.statement: Polyethylene cost swings can largely be passed on to customers up to a point.
items.quote: Largely, that ultimately is a cost for us at the cable level, and we feel fairly confident that up to a certain level that we are able to pass that on to our customers.

items.statement: Input costs have risen.
items.quote: There have been cost increases that Ajay spoke about in terms of our input costs.

items.statement: The margin upgrade comes from higher utilisation and better product and customer mix.
items.quote: And in terms of the upgrade or to the margins, I think it's a combination of 2, 3 things. I think it is certainly some amount of improvement in our capacity utilization, a good product mix and customer mix

items.statement: Data centre solutions carry higher margins than the telecom segment.
items.quote: yes, the margins broadly for the solutions we sell to data center are higher margins than the telecom segment.

items.statement: Capex is planned at about Rs 500 crore a year for three years, about Rs 1,500 crore in total.
items.quote: We expect about INR500 crores of investment per year for the next 3 years. So cumulatively, around INR1,500 crores is what we see over the 3 years.

items.statement: The announced US investment is $100 million over five years.
items.quote: So what we announced was a $100 million investment over a 5-year period.

items.statement: Capacity utilisation keeps improving quarter on quarter.
items.quote: we continue to see that our capacity utilization is improving quarter-on-quarter. So that's a positive development, and we continue to see that going forward as well.

items.statement: The company is upgrading equipment and debottlenecking current operations to add output.
items.quote: we are looking very closely at both upgrades of our equipment and machines, and we're also looking at debottlenecking from our current operations.

items.statement: Q1 order wins of Rs 13,100 crore were 1.7x the whole of last year's order wins.
items.quote: In quarter 1 alone, we secured orders worth INR13,100 crores, which is 1.7x the total order wins of INR7,687 crores recorded in the entire financial year last year.

items.statement: A multiyear $1.1 billion hyperscaler deal for AI data centre connectivity runs through FY29.
items.quote: The momentum is anchored by a landmark multiyear $1.1 billion deal with a global hyperscaler to supply optical connectivity products for next-gen AI data centers through FY29.

items.statement: The open order book reached a record Rs 18,618 crore, up 2.4x from last quarter.
items.quote: Our open order book stands at a record high of INR18,618 crores, up 2.4x from the last quarter, reflecting healthy order inflows and a strong market confidence.

items.statement: Net cash is Rs 483 crore, making the company net debt free.
items.quote: On balance sheet, the net cash balance stands at INR483 crores, achieving the status of net debt-free company.

items.statement: STL completed a Rs 1,500 crore QIP to fund growth.
items.quote: STL successfully completed a landmark QIP of INR1,500 crores to fund our next phase of growth.

items.statement: 75% of the QIP proceeds will go to debt reduction.
items.quote: We are allocating 75% of proceeds towards reduction of debt, while the rest of it going towards general corporate purposes.

items.statement: STL won its European patent dispute with Fujikura.
items.quote: we have secured definitive victory in a European patent dispute with Fujikura, and this matter has now been conclusively resolved in STL's favor.

items.statement: STL launched CONCAT, a spliceless plug-and-play product that cuts FTTH installation costs.
items.quote: In optical connectivity, we launched CONCAT, a spliceless plug-and-play solution designed for dramatically lowering the FTTH installation costs.

items.statement: STL won US Conec certification for MMC pre-terminated solutions offering 3x cable density.
items.quote: A major milestone this quarter is that we have achieved the elite US Conec certification for MMC Pre-Terminated solutions, delivering a massive 3x increase in cable density over traditional layouts

items.statement: Data centres are the fastest-growing fibre demand driver, with optical cable demand from them seen up 63% in 2026.
items.quote: Data centers are the fastest-growing driver of fiber demand. CRU projects a massive 63% global growth in optical cable demand from this segment in the year 2026 alone, driven by hyperscale expansion and AI workloads.

items.statement: Global cable demand is projected to grow 8.2% this year, led by North American data centres.
items.quote: As for CRU, the global cable demand market for this year has strengthened significantly and is projected to accelerate to 8.2% year-on-year, led mainly by North America data center build-out

items.statement: India's data centre capacity is set to grow about sevenfold to nearly 10 GW by 2031.
items.quote: Installed capacity is set to grow almost sevenfold, expanding from 1.6 gigawatts currently to almost 10 gigawatts by 2031, as per Morgan Stanley.

items.statement: Helium supply is being watched closely given Middle East developments.
items.quote: And when it comes to helium as well, we are watching that very closely with the developments in Middle East.

items.statement: Capacity limits now force the company to pick and choose orders.
items.quote: Obviously, now we are in a situation wherein we have to pick and choose the orders basis the capacity availability.

items.statement: The large gap in AI token costs between US and Chinese providers may eventually pressure prices.
items.quote: the price points will have to become more efficient and this large delta in cost of tokens between the U.S. cloud providers and China, there has to be something that has to give

items.statement: positive
items.quote: I'm happy to take you through our financial highlights for Q1 FY27, a truly historic quarter where STL delivered its highest ever performance across revenue, EBITDA and PAT.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 operational EBITDA was INR 685 crore at a 27.1% margin, up 624 bps quarter-on-quarter.
items.quote: our operational EBITDA for Q2 FY27 came in at INR 685 crore, delivering 27.1% margin or significant quarter-on-quarter expansion of 624 basis points.

items.statement: Revenue reached INR 2,529 crore, up 145% year-on-year.
items.quote: This quarter, revenue reached INR 2,529 crore, representing growth of 145% year-on-year.

items.statement: The attach rate hit a record 24% in H1 FY27, up from 20% a year earlier.
items.quote: our attached rate has reached an all-time high of 24% in H1 FY27, up from 20% in H1 FY26, and this was achieved on a much larger OFC revenue base.

items.statement: Net working capital days increased slightly in Q2.
items.quote: You see, broadly, you need to link it to our networking capital days, which while has increased slightly in Q2.

items.statement: Finance costs rose due to penalties on prepaying loans early.
items.quote: we have prepaid few of the loans, which were due at a later stage. And there were some penalties related to the prepayments, which we have squared off.

items.statement: The FY29 EBITDA margin target was raised to above 30% while the INR 20,000 crore revenue target was kept.
items.quote: Accordingly, we are upgrading our FY29 EBITDA margin targets to above 30%, up from 27% earlier. While maintaining our FY29 revenue targets at 20,000 crore.

items.statement: Capex of INR 1,000 crore per year is planned from 2027 to 2029, including a greenfield pre-terminated solutions facility.
items.quote: and a greenfield facility for pre-term solutions with a total capex of 1,000 crore per year from 2027 to 2029.

items.statement: The company is expanding preform, fiber and cable capacity by 50% and building a new greenfield facility.
items.quote: we're expanding our preform fiber and cable capacities by 50% and building a new greenfield facility for pre-terminated solutions.

items.statement: Utilization keeps improving quarter on quarter as raw material procurement improves.
items.quote: So overall, as a result of this, our utilization continues to improve quarter on quarter.

items.statement: The open order book reached a record INR 35,274 crore, 4.6 times the level at the start of the year.
items.quote: our open order book stands at record 35,274 crore, up 4.6 times from 7,687 crore at the start of this financial year.

items.statement: The largest win this quarter was a five-year agreement worth potentially USD 1.2 billion.
items.quote: The largest win this quarter is a new five-year agreement with a potential value of 1.2 billion dollars.

items.statement: H1 FY27 order wins of INR 32,000 crore were about four times all of FY26.
items.quote: In the first half of FY27, we secured orders worth 32,000 crores, this is roughly four times the orders we won in the whole of FY26.

items.statement: Data centers are the fastest-growing fiber demand driver, with CRU raising its 2026 growth projection to 89%.
items.quote: Data centers remain the fastest-growing driver for optical fiber demand. CRU recently upgraded its 2026 demand projections for this segment to 89% year-on-year, up sharply from 63% last quarter.

items.statement: CRU expects global optical cable demand to reach 851 million fiber km by 2031, a 7.5% CAGR.
items.quote: According to CRU, global optical cable demand has been upgraded again, and is now expected to reach 851 million fiber kilometers by 2031, reflecting a strong 7.5% CAGR through 2031.

items.statement: The shift to scheduled backlog gives more stable realizations through the cycle.
items.quote: It gives us more predictable revenue, better capacity planning, and more stable realizations through the cycle.

items.statement: Supply constraints have changed payment terms for purchased materials.
items.quote: Currently, this is a supply constant market. So a lot of materials which we have to buy the payment terms have changed.

items.statement: The 27% operational margin reflects higher utilization, a richer mix and more high-value optical connectivity.
items.quote: Excluding this one-off item, our 27% operational margin reflects strong underlying fundamentals driven by higher capacity utilization, a richer product, and customer mix, and an increasing share of high-value optical connectivity.

items.statement: Net cash improved to INR 703 crore from INR 483 crore, and the company remains net debt-free.
items.quote: On the balance sheet of net cash balance has improved to INR 703 crores, from 483 crore reported last quarter, and we continue to be a net debt-free company.

items.statement: CRISIL upgraded the long-term rating to AA stable.
items.quote: CRISIL has further upgraded our long-term rating to AA stable, from AA minus, and reaffirmed our short-term ratings at A1 plus.

items.statement: Management says H1 results set the company up well for the rest of FY27.
items.quote: In summary, these results demonstrate strong revenue momentum, expanding margins, and bottom-line execution, setting us up remarkably well for the remainder of FY27.

items.statement: The data center segment is on track to reach 50% of revenue this fiscal.
items.quote: Keeping us firmly on track towards scaling this segment to 50% of revenues in the current fiscal.

items.statement: Pre-terminated trunk assemblies were launched in September.
items.quote: The highlight this quarter is the launch of our pre-terminated trunk assemblies in September.

items.statement: The hollow core fiber cable moved into its first commercial pilot phase.
items.quote: Secondly, hollow core fiber, our HCF cable that offers between 30 to 47% lower latency had transitioned into first commercial pilot phase.

items.statement: Management flagged local execution challenges such as land, power, water and local opposition for data center projects.
items.quote: But also, we have to be mindful that there are some local execution challenges around you know, land, power, water. And you know, other local opposition.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: If Q1 was historic, Q2 has raised the bar again. For the second consecutive quarter, STL has delivered its highest-ever performance across revenue, EBITDA, and PAC.
